fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (my extrapolated 2028E EPS ~$7.0 x 40x = $280, 50%), EV/sales (2028E revenue ~$9.5B x 7.5x plus ~$3.0B net cash at Sept 2027 on ~330M diluted shares = $225, 30%) and a DCF (10% WACC, 4% terminal growth, FCF margin to 18% on ~$19.6B 2031 revenue, EV ~$51B plus ~$3.0B net cash = $165, 20%), giving ~$240 as of Sept 2027. The in-the-money 0% 2030 converts are treated as equity (already in the ~323M diluted count), so cash counts as net cash.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: Market in Sept 2027 prices 2028. FY2027 consensus non-GAAP EPS $4.93 (28 analysts, range $2.95-$7.01) on $6.79B revenue. 2028E EPS ~$7.0 is MY extrapolation (+~42%; no FY2028 consensus exists) on ~$9.5B revenue, ~24% op margin, ~330M diluted shares (323.3M Q2 2026 diluted count incl. convert shares, plus ~1-2%/yr SBC). 40x forward: premium for ~40% growth, below today's ~59x FY27 as growth decelerates. Morgan Stanley's 4.8 GW 2028 deployment forecast implies upside to $9.5B, which I treat as bull-case, not base.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: 2028E revenue ~$9.5B x 7.5x = ~$71B EV (raised from 7x so it is consistent with the P/E leg: ~18.5% net margin x 40x P/E = ~7.4x sales). Plus net cash ~$3.0B by Sept 2027 (6/30/26 cash $2.67B less ~$0.2B financing obligations = ~$2.45B, plus ~$0.5B FCF over the next 5 quarters); converts ($2.475B, conversion ~$194.97) treated as shares, not debt. / ~330M diluted shares = ~$225.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Revenue $4.05B 2026 growing 65%/45%/35%/25%/20% to ~$19.6B in 2031; FCF margin 14%->18% (2028-2031 FCF ~$1.4B/$2.1B/$2.8B/$3.5B); WACC 10%; terminal growth 4%; EV at Sept 2027 ~$51B; plus ~$3.0B net cash (converts as equity); ~330M diluted shares = ~$165.

bear.story: Project Jupiter slips materially (New Mexico air-quality permit denied or delayed at the Nov 23, 2026 deadline, or the Energy Transfer pipeline slips well past Feb 1, 2027) and units are not redeployed, while AI-capex digestion or neocloud financing tightens; FY27 guide in Feb 2027 lands well below the ~$6.8B consensus and EPS nearer $3; scandium/litigation overhang persists; multiple compresses to ~30x on ~$4 2028E EPS.

base.story: Execution continues: 2 GW capacity online end-2026, Jupiter is a timing issue not a loss (Oracle reaffirmed the 2.4 GW contract; more than half of the MS-estimated $8B+ equipment backlog is non-Oracle), FY27 revenue ~$6.8B and EPS ~$5, 2028E ~$7. Multiple de-rates from ~59x FY27 to ~40x 2028E, roughly offsetting earnings growth; ~$9/share of net cash supports value. Stock ends a little below today.

bull.story: Backlog converts faster, Jupiter permit approved on time, another hyperscaler-scale order and a formal commitment to expand Fremont toward 5 GW; deployments track MS's 1.8 GW 2027 / 4.8 GW 2028 path, 2028E EPS ~$9-10, and the market holds ~50x as the leading behind-the-meter AI power supplier.

thesis_break_reason: At ~$150 (-48%, below the ~$164 post-Q2 low) BE would be ~30x FY27 consensus EPS and ~21x a $7 2028E, only consistent with real estimate cuts: Jupiter cancelled or pushed past 2028 (permit denied Nov 23 or pipeline slipping far past Feb 2027 with no redeployment), a Feb 2027 FY27 guide well below ~$6.8B revenue, hyperscaler/neocloud order deferrals, gross margin back below ~30%, or a real scandium supply disruption. Moves to $170-230 are ordinary noise at 112% realized vol.

reasoning: Round 2. Supervisor fact-checks, which I verified, change my balance sheet treatment: the only large convert is the $2.2B (upsized, ~$2.5B with greenshoe) 0% 2030 note priced Oct 30, 2025 (not Feb 2026), conversion ~$194.97, deep in the money and already in the 323.3M Q2 diluted count. So ~$2.45B of cash is effectively net cash (~$7.5/share), rising to ~$3.0B by Sept 2027 with FCF; my round-1 'net debt ~0' double-counted, and my '$4B+ converts / 39% share growth' dilution worry was wrong (the diluted count jump reflects convert shares entering, not new issuance). I raised the EV/sales multiple to 7.5x so it matches the 40x P/E leg's implied margin. New legs: P/E $280 (unchanged, 2028E $7.0 labeled as my extrapolation), EV/sales $225, DCF $165, blended ~$240 (from $233). Oracle's Sep 24 force-majeure notice runs to developer Blue Owl as a lease-payment deferral right, not a cancellation; Oracle and Blue Owl reaffirmed and Bloom says the 2.4 GW contract stands; Morgan Stanley (base $310, bear $115, bull $520) estimates $8B+ equipment backlog, more than half non-Oracle, and forecasts 1.8 GW deployments in 2027. I add Jupiter permit/pipeline dates as explicit bear triggers but keep bear weight at 25% since it is mainly timing risk. Fundamentals (Q2 revenue +166%, FY26 guide $3.9-4.2B, FY27 consensus $4.93 EPS rising) remain strong while the stock sits ~59x FY27 and above my fair value. Median moved up to ~$265 (from ~$260), still below spot because forward-multiple de-rating absorbs most 2028 growth. Dispersion stays lognormal-like with sigma ~0.8 (below 112% realized, far above large-cap base rates) with slightly more left-tail mass for the Nov 23 permit binary. Scenario mean ($120/$265/$480 at 25/50/25) ~$283, consistent with the ladder. Round-2 research used ~5 searches; no options data or priors consulted.
